name: Sugasaki Ruri
source:
Deep down, she is a sweet and cute girl, but she’s too shy to show it. She ended up this way by just going along with the crowd. As for her current gyaru look—much like other high school girls these days—she’s starting to get bored with her tanned skin and is thinking it’s about time to give it up.

[from [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20041023222235/http://www.bishoge.jp/scoop/products/museum/yuwaku.htm]ScooP archived page[/url]]
